notes:
PRODUCTION WORKFLOW - USE N8N VARIABLES (Settings -> Variables)
Accessed in this workflow as $vars.NAME (NOT $env.NAME - $env is blocked in n8n expressions by default).

REQUIRED N8N VARIABLES:
1. BACKEND_API_URL = https://your-cloudflare-tunnel-url (no trailing slash)
2. BACKEND_API_KEY = (only needed if REQUIRE_API_KEY=true on the backend, else leave blank)
3. SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL = your Slack incoming webhook (rotate any previously-committed webhook immediately)
4. N8N_SUBSCRIBER_WEBHOOK_SECRET = a long random secret, must match backend's env var of the same name

Cron Schedule: 30 16 * * 1-5 (Mon-Fri 4:30 PM EST) - edit the Cron node to change.

Workflow Flow:
1. Health Check -> /api/health
2. IF unhealthy -> Slack alert + stop (no wasted scrape/FinBERT run on a dead backend)
3. Run Full Pipeline -> /api/run_pipeline (scrape + FinBERT + DB + signals, ~1-3 min on CPU)
4. Process Metrics -> ranks tickers by conviction, builds Top-3 movers + full breakdown
5. Fetch Subscribers -> /api/internal/subscribers (secret header)
6. Branch A: High Conviction -> Urgent Slack alert
   Branch B: Otherwise -> Daily summary Slack message
7. Email Dispatch -> HTML email to all subscribers
